semiconductor_relevance: High — Loadpoint specializes in high-precision motion systems used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as wafer dicing and grinding.
summary: Loadpoint is a UK-based manufacturer of high-precision motion systems with over 60 years of experience, focusing on air-bearing spindles and ultra-precision solutions for semiconductor applications. Their products are essential for processes requiring extreme precision and reliability, making them a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
capabilities: High-speed rotation systems for wafer grinding
Customized engineering support for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: Loadpoint has established a local team in China for sales, technical support, and after-sales service to better serve the Asian market.
